categories.name: Office
categories.description: Term dates and notices from the office.

posts.title: Open day on 14 November: lessons, tours and a student panel
posts.excerpt: Families can sit in on morning lessons and ask students anything in the afternoon.
posts.content:
Our autumn open day runs from 9:30 to 15:00 on Saturday 14 November. Families can sit in on two morning lessons, tour the laboratories and library, and join a student panel after lunch.

Places are free but limited; please book with the school office.

posts.title: Thank you for coming to the culture festival
posts.excerpt: Over two thousand visitors, forty-two club exhibits and one very long orchestra encore.
posts.content:
More than two thousand visitors came to this year’s culture festival. Forty-two clubs showed their work, from the robotics lab to the tea room run by the cooking club.

Photographs will be shared in the next term letter.

posts.title: Library open until eight from November
posts.excerpt: Longer evening hours for the exam season, with a librarian on duty.
posts.content:
From 2 November the library stays open until 20:00 on weekdays, with a librarian on duty and the quiet reading room heated.

Students in year 3 may book study carrels for the exam season.
